verdict.rationale: BVNK clearly versions its API: endpoints carry version paths (v1, v2), Transfers v.3 replaces the legacy Quote API with a migration guide, and a superseded webhook is documented as still fully supported with an unchanged payload. However, the pack shows no formal, published deprecation policy covering notice periods, sunset dates or support windows. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, explicit versioning scheme documentation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The Transfers v.3 API replaces the legacy Quote API for wallet-to-wallet currency conversion.
This guide walks you through the required changes for a successful migration.
This webhook is still fully supported, and its payload has not changed. You can switch to the new event whenever you are ready.
